sets.prompt:
Although many people claim to be concerned about what their information is used for, they use the services of online companies or social media platforms and share personal information with them. This inconsistency is called the Privacy Paradox.

Write an essay discussing the causes of the above phenomenon.

essays.title: Adequate for University Study
essays.text:
In the last decade, humanity was introduced with social medias. In the beginning, they thought that there are different advantages to use these platforms. After that, they had some questions about what their information used for. Although they had fear, they used the services of online companies or social media platforms and shared personel information with them. This inconsistency is called as the Privacy Paradox. This paradox is coming from limited access and fear of social isolation.

Firstly, one of the reason is fearing of social isolation for privacy paradox. Nowadays, most of the people find their girlfriends or boyfriends in the social media. According to the last studies, 45% of people meet with girlfriends and boyfriends in online applications. Moreover, they do not want to loose connections with their old friends. For example, thanks to Instagram, they can reach the last updates about their friends. Therefore, they contunie to use these platforms, even though they have concern.

Another reason is limited access for this paradox. People can hear the news from all around the world with these social medias, and they can reach these news very quickly. In addition, online applications are the another way to find true informations in some countries becasue television programs do not always give the all story. As a results of this, they can not close their accounts, allthough they do not feel comfortable about sharing their personal informations.

To sum up, people can not leave from social platforms due to privacy paradox. Therefore, online aplications should update their policy to protect to all informations.

essays.title: Doubts About Adequacy
essays.text:
Online companies or social media applications are an important part of our lives and millions of people cannot give up from these apps. However, they may cause to the some security problems such as information share. There are some important causes about why people still continue to use these apps even though they have a lot of concerns about their safety.

Firstly, for many users, social media is not only pleasure but also compulsory in the modern era. They use these apps for so crucial and important things like job possibilities, navigation, or communication. This means, their needs are more important than their fears about social media. Furthermore, millions of people use these apps and share personal information. This crowded provide relief for users who have anxiety because they think “if this situation is dangerous, why millions of people continue to using. Majority might be true.”

Secondly, fear of social isolation might explain why users still use these apps despite their concerns. It is hard to imagine those days which people didn't use mobile phones or technological devices. Moreover, new children don't know that how can they continue their life and keep social without technological devices. Thereby, they fear stay away from photos or shares of their friends. Actually, this result is not surprising because social media apps were created for addiction and their success can appear readily. Consequently, these addicted people don't care too much about their personal information or their addict tolerate their fear.

In conclusion, conditions and expectations of the modern world, and fear of being unsocial are major causes of the privacy paradox. Even though people's private lives in danger with online services, they should chose either stay away from social apps or take a risk. Not surprisingly, people opt for taking a risk and follow the path of other millions of users.

essays.title: Clearly More Than Adequate
essays.text:
Today, the internet is used in many areas in our lives. It is obvious that the internet has helped to process tasks effectively in various businesses. Nonetheless, considering our private life, it causes Privacy Paradox. There are three main causes to explain how the internet can cause privacy paradox.

To begin with, some of the services of online companies are provided only for those who share personal information so that the companies can send their advertisement e-mails. For instance, while you are reading an article in the website of the New York Times newspaper, you will see a warning sign indicating that you will not be allowed to continue unless you write your e-mail address, name, and surname.

Another reason for the Privacy Paradox is fear of social isolation. Nowadays, social media use is very widespread in the sense that many people prefer to use social media applications instead of face-to-face communications to socialize. From a psychological point of view, people tend to feel isolated if they avoid environments that they can interact with others. As a result, people use social media platforms, which require them to share personal information, to avoid social isolation.

Finally, there are lots of services on the internet require payment. On the other hand, some companies provide free access if you provide your personal information. To illustrate, many web-sites to watch movies like MUBI and Netflix which require payment. Therefore, some people prefer to use other web-sites that provide free access to the movies. Yet, they provide their personal information to those websites in detail.

All in all, in order to reach full contents of what they read, avoid social isolation, and access to free services, people share their private information online although they are concerned about what their information is used for.

essays.title: Very Good Academic English
essays.text:
In the recent years, several incidents have happened because of social media platforms' privacy policies. Even Mark Zuckerberg, the founder of Facebook, has been taken to court on the account of such incidents. Despite the protests following the court hearings, many people still continue to use Facebook to this day. This is an example of the Privacy Paradox, which is mainly caused by the fear of social isolation and the underestimation of the importance of digital privacy.

The people of today have become addicted to social media platforms. Two decades ago, friends used to meet face to face. After the popularity of social media, the term “online friendship” was coined. Furthermore, people started to feel obligated to share themselves on social media. Otherwise, they thought they would be “left behind” or socially “excommunicated” from their social circles. Hence, it is important for people to perform “reality checks” every now and then to assess the impact of the social media in their lives.

There is also the misunderstanding of digital privacy that many tend to have. Generally, masses do not realize how important their data is because they think that the information is too dispersed or insufficient for those who want to use it. In reality, it is the exact opposite. The 2016 US Presidential Election is a testament as to how people can be profiled, targeted and influenced through their data to induce a great social change. Therefore, the importance of digital privacy needs to be explained in further detail to social media users, and might even become a part of the regular curriculum as digital integration continues.

To sum up, even though the risks of social media are acknowledged, it is still a given that people will continue using it, perhaps even more than ever, as the Age of Information continues to digitize society.

essays.title: Doubts About Adequacy
essays.text:
Recent researchs indicates that the number of using the services of online companies or social media platforms and share personal information with them has increased drastically while they are concerned about what their information is used for. This behaviour is called the Privacy Paradox. Among all causes of this rise, limited access and fear of social isolation seen to be most common two.

To begin with, limited access otherwise can be considered to be the primary reason of Privacy Paradox. For instance, a person may want to buy a product which is selling the abroad, hence, he have to share his names and credit card numbers with the services of online companies even though he does not want to share his informations. Another example is, if we do not share our information with these companies we could not attend many things. For example, especially these days, because of covid19, everything is working on the internet. Therefore, we have to share our ID's with them.

Fear of social isolation is the second reason, which leads to Privacy Paradox. For example, the person who does not want to use social media platforms probably will miss many news about his friends or family members. Today communication is mostly working on the internet; if we do not use them, we might feel very lonely. Therefore, many people are using social media platforms, such as Instagram, Twitter, Facebook and so on.

In conclusion, limited access otherwise and fear of social isolation to be the two most significant reason why sharing personal information has displayed increase even though people are concerning about their informations. It is highly likely that this inconsistency will stay on the stage unless technology is devastated.

essays.title: Adequate for University Study
essays.text:
Social media is everywhere in our lives and someone can use these platforms for saving money. With the increase in social media use, there are many problems borned such as privacy paradox. If you already have a concern about what your information used for and you still share your information it is called privacy paradox. To be able to prevent harmful consequences of this issue, it is important to look at the causes of it. There are several causes of privacy paradox.

The first cause of this phenomenon might be fear of social isolation. Social media have some rules. When you want to use social media, you must share personal information with these platforms. If you do not give your number or e-mail to these platforms, there is no way to register. Besides, in the modern world those who do not have social media seems bigotry on other people's mind. Thus, those who have a fear of social isolation give their informations to online platforms.

In addition to fear of social isolation, free service opportunities may be the other cause of privacy paradox. Some companies have online pages in which they have products, and generally they sale these products in minimum wages. On the other hand, many companies give personal discount and prize cards for their customers if they register their website. However, if you want to buy these products in online shopping sites, you must share your address and credit card information. Otherwise, they can not deliver your product.

To sum up, there are some bright causes of this issue. These are fear of social isolation and free service opportunities. It is my contention that privacy paradox is growing and widespread concern in all world because technology force people to use online platforms. If governments produce restrictions against companies about security of people's personal information, people feel more relax and safe.

sets.prompt: It is estimated that around 60 percent of crimes are not reported to the police. On the opposite page, write an essay discussing the reasons why crimes are not reported to the police.
guidelines: lack of confidence in the legal system

essays.title: Clearly More Than Adequate
essays.text:
In our century, unfortunately, there is still a high rate of crime. People may think that we are getting better day by day and crime rates must decline, but it's not happening. Actually it's normal to think so not just because we're getting better, also our technology is enough to identify criminals. Then why do crime rates increase? The main reason is that people who are criminals are not reported to the police. There are several reason why crimes are not reported to the police.

First of all, it's easy to say that people must report the criminals but most of the time the people who have seen the crime know who the criminal is, and they don't want them to be judged. They may love the criminal or they think that the criminal is do what he/she needs to do, so they prefer to not report them to the police. People can say that it's all wrong to hide a crime, but they cannot understand Their (the people who have seen the crime) mental situation.

As the second reason, people may not trust the laws. They may think that “Nothing will change if I report the criminal or not; nobody going to punish him/her.” Due to this thought, majority of people don't want to report what or who they have seen. Unfortunately, it's hard to change their opinions about the laws most of the time. Lack of trust may be an obstacle to solve a crime, sadly.

In summary, there are many reasons for people to not say anything about the crime which they have seen. It's sad to lose some key informations about crime because of these reasons. Everyone needs to know that silence is not a solution.

If the person who committed a crime saw this citizen, too, citizen may feel fear and do not want to be involved to this case. In this case, they don't report to police and talk each other. They have some traditional solves such as giving a new cow or giving some money.

essays.title: Excellent
essays.text:
It is often perceived that any victim would be inclined to report any crime to local authorities with various motivations. Yet the number of actually reported crimes are estimated to be well below 50%. There could be very different approaches on how we would evaluate why so many crimes go unreported but for the sake of briefness, we will address them in four main points.

Firstly; the local authorities, mainly the police force, and the legal system in any given country are considered rather untrustworthy by the general public. There has been an abundance of publicized cases displaying police brutality, bribery, corruption, and straight up treason so that it is unfortunately fair to assume that the public has enough reasons to deem the police and the justice system as ineffective, unreliable, and probably corrupted to the core that almost every single law enforcement member is already in the pocket of a wealthy, influential businessman.

Secondly; the follow-up after an initial incarceration of a convict, and the protections of both witnesses and victims have demonstrated notoriously poor results. Out of fear of retaliation from family members and/or loved ones of convicts, people go off the grid or even go as far as to retracting their official testimonies to no avail. These people have already been victims, and they still spend the rest of their lives constantly on the lookout for potentially fatal acts of revenge.

Thirdly, domestic violence, specially, after the previous decade, is now off the charts. Primarily women and children are victims of domestic abuse, yet statistics show that they tend to cover it up instead of going to authorities or seeking legal help like mainly a divorce or restraining order as the last resort. Experts believe the reason behind that is the victims are affiliated with assailants in such close proximity that leaving and/or reporting them doesn't even seem to be a plausible and realistic option. To them, the person is not an abuser, that's just their dad who has anger issues, their mother with drinking problems and so on.

And finally, sometimes in a delusional state, but sometimes in a perfectly functional, totally capable state, people believe that nothing happened to them or that it really wasn't that big of a deal. Therefore, the crimes they were a victim of go unnoticed. To conclude; the lack of resource for a victim and the constant fear of danger for an already traumatized victim makes it really hard for them to report a crime or even make them unwilling to report it.

Maintaining order in society is a hard and crucial task that we humans accomplish by laws and punishment. We expect criminals to get some kind of punishment but this is hardly the case. One of the main reasons of this is that some crimes are not reported to the police. Although letting a criminal go unpunished sounds horrible, people have valid reasons to not report a crime.

Main reason behind people's silence is lack of confidence in the legal system. Where ever we go in the world, we can see that the justice system is controlled by rich people and politicians. Even if a politician is not accused of any crime and got nothing to do with a case, they can influence the outcome of any trial just to impose their political views. When people know about these, they choose to be silent rather than being a political target and losing lots of money along with the trial.

Unfortunately, lack of confidence in the justice system creates another problem which pushes more and more people into silence. essays.title: Clearly More Than Adequate
essays.text:
We see many news regarding crimes almost every day. Justice is what everyone needs, but in order to establish this, authorities have to know about the crimes. Approximately 60% of crimes are not reported to the police. Two reasons can be given that cause this situation.

First reason is the fear of revenge. Victims are afraid that the offender will come back for them for revenge if they report to the police. For example, if someone tried to kill the victim or threatened them to do so, he/she would be scared to report this because there is a possibility that police investigation will take too long, or there will be lack of evidence for further investigation, which means he/she might get killed before the investigation even started.

Second reason is the closeness to the offender. To exemplify, the cousin of the victim might be guilty for stealing their money and he/she would be hesitant to report it to authorities since they are relatives. Another example is, unfortunately, rape that is committed within the family. Sometimes, the victim cannot even think of a way to prove this let alone reporting it.

In conclusion, if we want justice, it would be better to focus on the reasons why crimes are not reported in the first place, two of these reasons are the closeness of the person who committed the crime and the fear of revenge.

sets.prompt: In some states of the U.S.A., a law has been proposed to ban teachers from directly communicating with students on social networking sites. Write an essay discussing your opinion on student–teacher communication on social networking sites.
guidelines_against: disadvantage for students with no social media accounts

essays.title: Far Below Adequacy
essays.text:
Communication is an important part of our lives. In contemporary country, people have not enough time to interaction with others. They have to go work or school. And they spend a large amount of time in traffic, so people don't have time to set up healthy communication with others.

For example, a student spent huge time in school, he/she see more his teachers than his parents or his friends. Due to some reasons, a student should be in communication with teacher by social networking sites or internet.

Some of people against to student–teacher communication on social networking sites due to some reasons. But it is important for closer relationship between teacher and student.

Sometimes we can think that teacher and student have not a professional distance because of social networking sites. But there is a freedom of communication for student and teacher.

In conclusion, despite some of people are against to student–teacher communication on social networking sites, some of people don't against.

essays.title: Clearly More Than Adequate
essays.text:
Media is an umbrella term which cover mass communication methods that aim to inform, educate and entertain the general public. In this sense, social networking sites are considered to be the most effective tools that media utilise such as Facebook or Twitter. Such sites enable people to interact with each other readily and rapidly. Also, a relation can be built between teachers and students by means of these social networking sites after the end of the school. However, in some states, whether communication between teacher and students on social networking sites should be banned or not is a matter of controversy. While some people are against it, others, including me, support it.

People who oppose to this implementation put forward that a good relationship between teachers and students is quite important for students' success; therefore, as long as there is a connection between teachers and students, the level of intimacy increases between them, which encourages students to work hard. This view may be right to some extent; yet, they ignore a significant point. This communication may deviate from its primary purpose. That is, interaction that is supposed to increase students' motivation may provide the basis for inappropriate relationships between teachers and students. In this sense, teachers and students can interact with each other whenever they want, which may cause undesirable and inappropriate relationships between teacher and student.

Objectors of this issue also maintain that social network websites can be used as a teaching tool because, in this way, the process of education becomes easy and fast. It may seem valid at the first glance; yet, it is superficial. People live in a world in which technology develops constantly, but just because technology is advanced does not mean that all students have a social media account. This being the case, if social networking sites are used as teaching tools, students who do not have any social media account are deprived of their right to receive education.

To sum up, it is logical to enact laws that ban communication between teachers and students because such interaction paves the way for not only inappropriate relationships but also deprivation of the right to receive education.

Secondly, [essay incomplete]

essays.title: Adequate for University Study
essays.text:
The world has been globalizing every passing day. This globalization has brought many new concepts especially in the area of technology. As a result, the internet has become very significant for communication such as Facebook, Twitter, Instagram etc. Some people believe that teachers should use social media more, because it contains many benefits for students. On the other hand, unavoidable disadvantages of social media can be seen in many cases. Although some people support the social media usage for teachers, it is disadvantageous for some students and it is directly against professional life.

Using social media requires some economical wealth and time, similarly, it is not a must for students. Firstly, there are many poor and rich students at schools. They both don't have the same chance to get a smartphone or computer. It is a fact that a computer or phone is a personal tool, which means people should buy them with their own money. Therefore, economic conditions create unbalanced consequences for students. Secondly, using social media is optional. It is not specified anywhere as a must. Therefore, students who don't want to use social media will be a disadvantaged group. They cannot reach possible online lectures, teacher talks etc. As a result, social media communication between student and teacher creates negative consequences for students who don't have enough financial support or are not willing to use social media.

Professional life needs privacy and control by others, so social media is a platform which is against both of these. Firstly, social media can show any information about teachers such as address, phone number etc. If so, some students who want to harm or threaten their teachers can reach teachers' homes, their children etc. with the aid of social media. There are many examples of teachers being harmed by their students. Secondly, schools should have the power to control the relationship between students and teachers. In social media, privacy is completely secured by companies. Hence, it causes inappropriate relationships between students and teachers. Even if the teacher uses social media carefully, it cannot be controlled by the school. All in all, privacy and control are not supported in social media, it is against professional life.

As a conclusion, people are discussing the positive and negative aspects of social media use between students and teachers. It is deeply explained that it causes disadvantages for some students in terms of economical conditions and motivation to use social media. On the other hand, it is completely against professional life in my point of view as well as in education.

essays.title: Not Adequate
essays.text:
People use social networking sites almost for everything nowadays. They are very popular because people can talk to each other quickly thanks to them. If they are so popular, there is no surprise in using them for education. Teachers are connecting with their students on these sites. However, some topics are discussed as to whether student–teacher communication on sites should occur or not.

Research shows that the best way to good communication is to listen and try to understand. Thus, teachers must be friendly with their students. Social networking sites are a useful tool to bring teachers and students closer. If students do not feel their teachers close enough, they will never tell their problems easily. In addition, students learn many things from their teachers beyond the lesson. Past experiments showed that formal and strict education was not a good way to foster good communication.

Creating strong and free individuals is another main goal of teachers. It means that when a teacher graduates their students, they want their students to be encouraged in society. Social networking sites have a positive effect on that because this area gives students that comfort. Students can talk easily because, as mentioned in the previous paragraph, they feel close to their teachers, so they can communicate freely.

People who are against this argue that it is not a professional environment and there is no privacy for both students and teachers. They might be right in some things such as social life. However, people must break some taboos. Teachers and students are people just like everyone else. Of course they have a life outside of school. In addition, knowing their social qualities or family members should not be a problem.

To sum up, student–teacher communication on sites is very useful and significant in my opinion. Students are more equal and close than before with their teachers. The unforgettable thing must be that every student and their teachers respect each other's personal life.

essays.title: Doubts About Adequacy
essays.text:
In today's world, social media has big importance for people. Thanks to social media, information is shared quickly, and people access it easily. Student–teacher communication on social networking sites is a very popular topic these days. Some people argue that this situation creates good results but in my opinion student–teacher communication on social networking sites is not appropriate and beneficial.

First of all, the relationship between student and teacher should not be like a friendship for better education. Because of human nature, very close relationships cause lack of discipline. In addition, too much interaction on social media can cause inappropriate relationships and teachers cannot be objective in some of their duties such as grading exams or homework. Therefore, for their mutual benefit, not only teachers but also students should act professionally.

Secondly, now internet and smartphones are definitely more common than in the past. However, still some students don't have internet. Therefore, students who have internet can be more advantaged. This situation causes inequality in education.

On the other hand, some people argue that thanks to student–teacher communication on social networking sites, students start to see teachers as role models. However, social media is not necessary for this result. A teacher's actions in daily life can affect students too.

In conclusion, some people claim that student–teacher communication on social networking sites should be supported but in my view, this situation can cause ethical problems and bad consequences.

essays.title: Very Good Academic English
essays.text:
In today's world, social media is a huge part of many people's everyday life and with the easy access it comes with, anyone with an internet connection can use it, including children. The easy access children have to social media can both be good or bad, depending on how it is used, and the attention of the adult responsible for the child.

When it comes to education, and the ties between school students and teachers over social media, some concepts can be controversial. In some states of the U.S.A., teachers are not allowed to communicate with their students over social media for a number of reasons the public is concerned with, including the disruption of the professional relationship teachers and students are expected to have and the invasion of the student's personal space on social media sites.

First of all, it is true that communicating over the internet may create a more unprofessional relationship between the teacher and the student; however, this is not always true and does not necessarily have negative outcomes. If these tools of technology are used correctly, teachers can integrate the students into learning more efficiently, and build better bonds with them which will end up affecting the learning process positively.

One negative result of this may be the disadvantage faced by students who do not have access to social media. However, this problem can be fixed by giving them access to computers at school, which provide a safer browsing option for young students.

Secondly, people argue that students deserve a personal space online that is away from teachers and other school staff, so that they can be themselves and not worry about being observed. However, this goes against the purpose of such online platforms. Moreover, most platforms offer an option which allows the user to limit the people who can view their activity and improve privacy.

In conclusion, the internet and social media are just tools that can be used for both good and ill. Limitations on such platforms will not only fail to get rid of the problems they may bring, but will also eliminate their potential — in this case, a better learning tool and a platform through which teachers and students can connect more effectively.

sets.prompt:
As a result of urban transformation, in most mega cities such as Istanbul, New York, Shanghai and Singapore, high-rise residential buildings with tiny apartments and no balconies are constructed block by block.

“High-rise residential buildings are undesirable places to live in.”
Write an essay arguing for or against the above statement.
guidelines_for: unhealthy child development (inadequate space for play/study)
guidelines_against: in-building fitness center, swimming pool, spa, etc.

essays.title: Not Adequate
essays.text:
Cities are growing due to the technology. Thereby, a lot of high technological buildings are builded. These buildings include various characteristics to help people live a better life. However, it also contains some negative specialties so there are many arguments about whether people live in these places or not.

First of all, high technological places provide better life to people. For example, these places have 7/24 security so that there are lower stealing situations against normal houses. Furthermore, they are very big and very expensive and these buildings are called high-rise residential buildings also. In these places, people do not need to go outside because of the fact that the place includes all needs that people want. For instance, they have fitness centers, pools, spas, car parking areas and even they have a mall. Furthermore, the residences own smart systems like our smart phones that all people use. The smart system is used against any natural disasters. As a result, people who live in these places do not die because of natural disasters.

Some people claim that living in such places reduces some required human behaviours. Because of the fact that people do not need to go outside, their relationships diminish and they can stay by themselves. Besides, children who are born in high-rise residential buildings face unhealthy growing, because they do not need to do any activities. They find out in their residence whatever they want to do. Moreover, these places are sold at very high prices. People can spend all their money buying these houses, and there is no money left behind. Beside these negative effects, these places can be bought for a more relaxing life.

In conclusion, high-rise residential buildings have been argued about whether they are needed or not. Before people buy such houses, they must think profoundly about whether they affect their benefits or harms.

essays.title: Not Adequate
essays.text:
Since the Industrial Revolution started, many advances in technology have emerged. Besides these developments, the revolution has also brought about some problems such as excessive population growth. Accordingly, this growth has led to housing shortages in mega cities. To overcome these shortages, a lot of high-rise residential buildings have been built in such cities. Many claim that these buildings are very comfortable and have many utilities; however, I believe that high-rise residential buildings are undesirable places to live in.

Many argue that these buildings have so many opportunities such as in-building fitness centers, swimming pools, and supermarkets that everyone can satisfy his/her needs by using them. This argument has some degree of truth in it. However, I believe that these facilities have some drawbacks in terms of economical and health aspects. To clarify, these services such as swimming pools are not free generally, and buying a flat in these buildings costs too much. Additionally, these facilities such as fitness centers and cinemas destroy the tie between people and nature. To put it differently, people choose doing sports in fitness centers rather than walking in the forest. In the long run, this situation is harmful for human health.

Another argument in favor of high-rise residential buildings is that they are smart homes. That is to say, there are many built-in appliances and technological developments in those homes. So many say that each family can meet its needs and desires by using only the house's opportunities. However, I think this fact makes people less social. People living in these buildings begin to stop interacting with neighbors. They think they can handle everything by themselves using the home technology. Consequently, this fact leads people to become lonely.

In a nutshell, high-rise residential buildings may affect people negatively. Residents shouldn't ignore the nature and the life with their neighbors. Otherwise, they can't benefit from these buildings effectively and their psychology gets worse.

essays.title: Far Below Adequacy
essays.text:
Istanbul is the most crowded city in Turkey but it is 35th in terms of km² measures. The population must live in this small city. The government and companies respond to this requirement with high-rise residential buildings.

High-rise residential buildings are very useful for older people. Our grandparents don't need to worry about setting the home's temperature. The staff sets the temperature for the whole apartment.

Secondly, these buildings have security and they are safe. At this time, robbery rates are very high compared to rural areas. Therefore, we have opportunities regarding security. Another problem is children's safety. Children should spend time outside the home in their daily lives. We must provide their security but we cannot always be near them. Our building security ensures security for our homes, cars, children…

Finally, we live in a crowded city. This is a very big problem but we can solve this problem via high-rise residential buildings.

essays.title: Very Good Academic English
essays.text:
Imagine a house with two floors, three bedrooms, and two bathrooms, a gigantic living space and a backyard full of trees. It sounds like a quite pleasant place to live in. Although living in a house as mentioned above bears many advantages, in the light of the evidence such as fitness center, swimming pool, security services within the building and transportation opportunities, it is evident that living in a high-rise residential building in the city center offers so much more.

Firstly, living in a high-rise residential building enables residents to use its exclusive benefits such as in-building fitness center, swimming pool, often a laundromat and maybe even a market. Thanks to these undeniable privileges the residents receive, there is no necessity to leave the building or to pay a fitness center separately. It is also worth considering that high-rise residential buildings provide extensive security services; there is therefore no need to be concerned about a possible robbery.

Secondly, high-rise residential buildings are mainly located in or near the city center. In addition, there are usually multiple transportation options such as metro or tram in the vicinity. Furthermore, these high-rise residential buildings tend to have a positive impact on their neighborhood as well. Since many people live in a high-rise building, more services such as hospitals, schools, malls and restaurants open around hoping to exploit the increasing population.

Although there are some considerable advantages to living in a high-rise residential building, it bears some disadvantages as no rose is without a thorn. High-rise residential buildings often require monthly payments in order to maintain their services and the price may be higher than expected. However, the services such as security, fitness center, and swimming pool all necessitate a staff and many require monthly or yearly maintenance. As far as I am concerned, the exclusive services residents receive compensate for the relatively high living costs.

Having assessed both sides of the argument, it is clear that the advantages outweigh the disadvantages. Today, transportation, healthcare and education have a significant influence on people's decisions, and it is evident that in those fields, high-rise residential buildings offer undeniable advantages.

essays.title: Adequate for University Study
essays.text:
The world's population is increasing rapidly, so high buildings are built in order to provide people with houses. Nowadays, these high buildings are becoming more modern. There are high residential buildings which include almost everything that people need. However, there is a discussion about whether high residential buildings are desirable. High residential buildings are desirable places to live in because they have everything that we need.

In great cities, there are a lot of problems. Finding a parking place is one of these problems. Millions of people live in cities, and almost everyone has their own car. It's hard to find a place to park because of this situation. However, high residential buildings have their own underground parking for every resident of the building. In addition, traffic jams hinder people from satisfying their demands like going to the mall. High-rise residential buildings have a mall, and there is no need to drive a car anymore. In these respects, these buildings keep people away from cities' traffic and parking problems.

Security and safety are significant concerns in urban life. There are many criminals in cities. Unemployment is another factor which leads people to steal. In this condition, people need a safe place to live. High residential buildings satisfy this safety demand. These buildings protect people from theft and crime by their 7/24 security. Thus people can live in these places without any safety concern.

Opponents claim that people who live in high-rise residential buildings have no ties with their neighbors. It's not entirely wrong. These buildings hinder people from having ties with their neighbors to some extent. However, residents in these buildings have fitness centers, swimming pools, cinemas, and lots of opportunities which allow people to make contact with their friends and neighbors.

Increased population forces people to build high and well-equipped buildings like high-rise residential buildings. Despite some opposing opinions, they provide people many opportunities like underground parking, 7/24 security, fitness centers, and more. Thus, these are desirable places to live in.

essays.title: Doubts About Adequacy
essays.text:
From past to now people's needs changed and also their environment where they live and reside changed. In the past people were living in small homes in a peaceful atmosphere. However population is growing and people need more and more homes. In this case, high buildings are built to live in. Some people think that these buildings are undesirable while others think that they are proper for living in. In this light, I support the view that high-rise residential buildings are undesirable places to live in.

First of all, there is no private space in these buildings. There are many flats in one big structure and this means there are a lot of people as neighbors. A family does not act how it wants. In fact, the family must obey some rules because people live there together. Besides, they have to do things without disturbing their neighbors or causing noise.

In addition to private space, people who live in high-rise residential buildings have no ties with nature. The first cause of this is that they raise their children within an apartment and children grow up without seeing a forest, for example. Also, this situation causes unhealthy development for children. Another aspect is that having no connection with nature leads to mental or psychological problems for people who reside there. For example, these people always see city structures and this causes stress.

On the other hand, some people argue that living in a high-rise residential building is desirable. Their most important point is that these buildings have amenities such as underground parking, shopping centres and roof gardens. These seem very high quality; however, the reality is not always like that. People do not necessarily need these for living. These are for entertainment and all of these mean more people and so much noise.

To sum up, although some people claim that high-rise residential structures are suitable for living, I do not agree. High-rise residential buildings are not appropriate and desirable to live in. In crowded cities people want a silent and peaceful atmosphere; however, these buildings do not provide a quiet and livable environment.
